purpose: Retail-reference feature seeds, independent of selected port files. Not an exhaustive catalogue or implementation claim.

manual-en.kind: publisher manual supplied with the installed game
manual-en.locator: Printed page numbers; PDF spreads contain two printed pages.
manual-en.limitation: Describes expected behavior; does not prove exact installed-version or Vita behavior. No manual payload is distributed.

features.expectation: Reach tutorial, campaign, saved games and multiplayer Practice through their original menus.
Select, load and delete saved games through the original load screen.
Completed missions update the campaign save for the furthest reached mission.
Quick saves alternate between two slots and restore the saved position and state.
Create named manual saves through EVA without the quick-save slot limit.
Rated mission saves permit difficulty replays without advancing the campaign.
EVA pauses single-player and exposes objectives, map and discovered intelligence categories.
New encounters and objectives update available character, weapon, vehicle and building intelligence.
Collecting a data disc updates available mission intelligence.
Required objectives control mission completion through their original state transitions.
Optional objectives retain their authored information, supply, vehicle and reinforcement rewards.
Cycle current objectives, show remaining objectives and review complete status in EVA.
Current objectives retain world direction and distance indicators.
Preserve difficulty, completion-time, optional-objective and save/load usage rank factors; audit the counter semantics.
Preserve walking, running, jumping, crouching and ladder traversal.
Retain first-person and third-person camera modes.
Use switches, lifts, consoles and terminals with their authored effects.
Collected keycards retain their graded access restrictions.
Display health, armor, loaded ammunition, reserve ammunition and weapon identity.
Show target identity, affiliation, health and hostility brackets.
Preserve target-lock, obstruction and reloading reticle states.
Radar distinguishes personnel, vehicles, structures and objectives through shape and color.
Show directional damage feedback and environmental hazard damage.
Present incoming EVA messages and objective notifications.
Show collected-item feedback and leave unusable full-capacity pickups in the world.
Preserve distinct partial and full health/armor pickup effects.
Retain weapon groups, within-group cycling, weapon cycling and reload behavior.
Keep each weapon's primary fire and applicable secondary effect.
Enter sniper scope and adjust scope zoom through original weapon behavior.
Deploy remote C4 and activate its secondary detonation behavior.
Preserve timed and proximity C4 behavior in the documented multiplayer context.
Repair guns retain vehicle/defense repair and C4/beacon disarming.
Enter eligible ground vehicles, leave vehicles and show entry availability.
Retain driver, gunner and passenger roles and their distinct control ownership.
The driver controls the vehicle weapon when no gunner occupies the vehicle.
Retain opposing-base destruction and eligible beacon victory conditions.
Friendly purchase terminals retain character, vehicle, supply and beacon transactions.
Internal master-control terminals retain building damage/destruction consequences.
Power-plant destruction affects purchase costs, base defenses and terminal power status.
Harvesters collect and return resources with shared team credit awards.
Harvester replacement depends on the surviving refinery and vehicle-production buildings.
Preserve the documented funding behavior on maps without a refinery.
Destroyed infantry/vehicle production buildings restrict their associated purchases.
Beacon arming retains progress, movement/fire interruption and deployment timing.
Distinguish general beacon destruction from pedestal-dependent victory.
Preserve global and team in-game chat through supported session providers.
Original control options retain movement, attack, look/use and communication actions.
Retain meaningful audio, video and performance configuration through Vita boundaries.
Previously encountered movies remain available through original unlock and replay ownership.
The original credits remain reachable and presentable.
